name: loop-pause
title_zh: 会先问清断点再停循环的暂停开关
tagline_zh: 在长跑项目里想停又怕丢进度？它先确认你停在哪一步、记下断点，下次从原处接着跑，不重来不迷路。
tagline_en: Need to stop a long-running loop without losing your place? It checks where to pause, records the breakpoint, and.
desc_en: Use when the user asks to pause, stop, halt or wind down the orchestrator loop, or to "get to a clean stopping point" so it can be resumed later, in a project that has claude-work/loop.json.
why_zh: 不是硬停，而是先和你对齐「干净断点」，把状态写进 loop.json，让暂停变成可恢复的中场休息。
why_en: Not a hard stop—it aligns on a clean breakpoint and saves state to loop.json, turning pause into a resumable intermission.
limit_zh: 只认 claude-work/loop.json 格式的编排循环；非此类项目或没有该文件时不会触发，需手动处理。
limit_en: Only works with claude-work/loop.json orchestration loops; without that file or in other project types, it won't trigger.
title_en: Pause switch that confirms your stopping point before.
